The role also involves monitoring emerging technologies and leading R&amp;D or continuous‑improvement initiatives to shape future generations of imaging packages.</p><p></p><p></p><p></p><p><b>What You’ll Do</b></p><p></p><p></p><p>Management of the full design flow of organic and ceramic multi-layers microelectronics packaging (BGA, PGA, CLCC, CQFP, WLCSP):</p><ul><li>Identify customers’ needs.</li><li>Devise a solution and a specification.</li><li>Interact with packaging manufacturers to obtain a solution and a quote all along the design process.</li><li>Interacting with project teams (sensor designers, project manager…)</li><li>Implement the design &#43; routing of the package in accordance with the constraints and timing as originally defined.</li><li>Conduct, electrical, thermal and mechanical simulations when necessary.</li><li>Conduct DRC checks in accordance with e2v methodologies.</li><li>Conduct different design reviews including the final one before ordering the package.</li><li>Assume the role of design expert with respect to assembly houses (assembly instructions…)</li></ul><p>Ensure technical interface with package vendors and assembly houses:</p><ul><li>Guide technical reviews with package vendors.</li><li>Technical Identification and evaluation of new vendors.</li></ul><p>Technology monitoring :</p><ul><li>Maintain a technology watch on future generations of imaging packages.</li><li>Identify and lead R&amp;D or continuous improvement projects on these technologies.</li></ul><p></p><p></p><p><b>Why Join Us</b></p><p></p><p></p><p>A strong customer focused individual (active listening and customers satisfaction), team-worker, with ability to adapt and communicate on subjects requiring rigor.</p><p>Autonomy to plan for results &amp;
